SerrePositivity.theorem_3_1_K0.type:
SerrePositivity.theorem_3_1_K0 : ∀ (A T : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
  [inst_3 : CommRing T] [inst_4 : Algebra A T] [Module.Finite A T] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
  [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) p] {e : ℕ} (z : Fin e → A),
  (Ideal.span (Set.range z)).radical = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A →
    ∀ (G : Type u_1) [inst_8 : Group G] [Finite G] [inst_10 : MulSemiringAction G T] [inst_11 : SMulCommClass G A T],
      Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A T)) →
        SerrePositivity.IsGeometricallyTransitive A T G →
          ∀ (y : SerrePositivity.K0Supported T (⇑(algebraMap A T) ∘ z)),
            (∀ (g : G), g • y = y) → ∃ n x, 0 < n ∧ n • y = (SerrePositivity.K0.map (algebraMap A T)) x
SerrePositivity.theorem_3_1_K0.axioms: 'SerrePositivity.theorem_3_1_K0' depends on axioms: [propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

SerrePositivity.normalizedLength_tor_of_.type:
@SerrePositivity.normalizedLength_tor_of_isWeaklyRegular : ∀ {A C : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : CommRing C]
  (φ : A →+* C) [inst_2 : IsLocalRing A] {e : ℕ} (z : Fin e → A),
  Ideal.span (Set.range z) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A →
    RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular A (List.ofFn z) →
      ∀ (lam : SerrePositivity.NormalizedLength C (Ideal.map φ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A))) (r : ℕ),
        (∀ (i : ℕ), 0 < i → lam.len (SerrePositivity.koszulHomologySelf (⇑φ ∘ z) i) = 0) →
          lam.len (C ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range (⇑φ ∘ z))) = ↑r →
            ∀ (V : Type u_1) [inst_3 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_4 : Module A V],
              IsFiniteLength A V →
                (∀ (i : ℕ), 0 < i → lam.len (SerrePositivity.TorAlg φ i V) = 0) ∧
                  lam.len (SerrePositivity.TorAlg φ 0 V) = ↑r * ↑(Module.length A V) ∧
                    ∀ (i : ℕ), lam.len (SerrePositivity.TorAlg φ i V) ≠ ⊤

SerrePositivity.lemma_3_4.type:
SerrePositivity.lemma_3_4 : ∀ (A T C : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : IsRegularLocalRing A]
  [inst_2 : CommRing T] [inst_3 : IsLocalRing T] [inst_4 : Algebra A T] [Module.Finite A T] [inst_6 : CommRing C]
  [inst_7 : Algebra T C] [inst_8 : Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A T C] {e : ℕ} (z : Fin e → A),
  Ideal.span (Set.range z) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A →
    ringKrullDim A = ↑e →
      ∀ (lam : SerrePositivity.NormalizedLength C (Ideal.map (algebraMap T C) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal T))),
        (∀ (v : ℕ),
            0 < v →
              ∀ (i : ℕ),
                0 < i → lam.len (SerrePositivity.koszulHomologySelf (fun j => (algebraMap A C) (z j ^ v)) i) = 0) →
          (∀ (v : ℕ),
              0 < v →
                lam.len (C ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range fun j => (algebraMap A C) (z j ^ v))) =
                  ↑(v ^ e * Module.finrank A T)) →
            ∀ (V : Type u_1) [inst_10 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_11 : Module A V],
              Module.length A V ≠ ⊤ →
                (∀ (i : ℕ), 0 < i → lam.len (SerrePositivity.TorAlg (algebraMap A C) i V) = 0) ∧
                  lam.len (SerrePositivity.TorAlg (algebraMap A C) 0 V) = ↑(Module.finrank A T) * ↑(Module.length A V) ∧
                    ∀ (i : ℕ), lam.len (SerrePositivity.TorAlg (algebraMap A C) i V) ≠ ⊤

SerrePositivity.lemma_3_5c.type:
@SerrePositivity.lemma_3_5c : ∀ {A T C : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : CommRing T] [inst_2 : Algebra A T]
  [inst_3 : CommRing C] [inst_4 : Algebra T C] [inst_5 : Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A T C] {e : ℕ} {z : Fin e → A}
  [inst_7 : IsRegularLocalRing A] [Module.Finite A T]
  {lam : SerrePositivity.NormalizedLength C (Ideal.map (algebraMap A C) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A))},
  Ideal.span (Set.range z) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A →
    ringKrullDim A = ↑e →
      (∀ (i : ℕ), 0 < i → lam.len (SerrePositivity.koszulHomologySelf (⇑(algebraMap A C) ∘ z) i) = 0) →
        lam.len (C ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range (⇑(algebraMap A C) ∘ z))) = ↑(Module.finrank A T) →
          (∀ (v j : ℕ), lam.len (SerrePositivity.koszulHomologySelf (fun k => (algebraMap A C) (z k ^ v)) j) ≠ ⊤) →
            ∀ [inst_9 : IsLocalRing T],
              Function.Surjective ⇑((IsLocalRing.residue T).comp (algebraMap A T)) →
                ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) p] (G : Type u_1) [inst_12 : Group G]
                  [inst_13 : Fintype G] [inst_14 : MulSemiringAction G T] [inst_15 : SMulCommClass G A T],
                  Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A T)) →
                    SerrePositivity.IsGeometricallyTransitive A T G →
                      ∀ (P : SerrePositivity.PerfSupp T (⇑(algebraMap A T) ∘ z)),
                        ∑ g, SerrePositivity.chiOrd (SerrePositivity.twist g ↑P) =
                          ∑ g, SerrePositivity.chiLam lam (algebraMap T C) (SerrePositivity.twist g ↑P)
SerrePositivity.lemma_3_5c.axioms: 'SerrePositivity.lemma_3_5c' depends on axioms: [propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

SerrePositivity.lemma_3_5a.type:
@SerrePositivity.lemma_3_5a : ∀ {A T C : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : CommRing T] [inst_2 : Algebra A T]
  [inst_3 : CommRing C] [inst_4 : Algebra T C] [inst_5 : Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A T C] {e : ℕ} {z : Fin e → A}
  [inst_7 : IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [Module.Finite A T]
  {lam : SerrePositivity.NormalizedLength C (Ideal.map (algebraMap A C) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A))},
  (Ideal.span (Set.range z)).radical = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A →
    (∀ (v j : ℕ), lam.len (SerrePositivity.koszulHomologySelf (fun k => (algebraMap A C) (z k ^ v)) j) ≠ ⊤) →
      (∀ (P : SerrePositivity.PerfSupp T (⇑(algebraMap A T) ∘ z)) (i : ℤ),
          Module.length T ↑(HomologicalComplex.homology (↑P) i) ≠ ⊤) ∧
        (∀ (P : SerrePositivity.PerfSupp T (⇑(algebraMap A T) ∘ z)) (i : ℤ),
            lam.len ↑(HomologicalComplex.homology (SerrePositivity.baseChange (algebraMap T C) ↑P) i) ≠ ⊤) ∧
          (∃ χ,
              ∀ (P : SerrePositivity.PerfSupp T (⇑(algebraMap A T) ∘ z)),
                χ (SerrePositivity.K0.mk P) = SerrePositivity.chiOrd ↑P) ∧
            ∃ χ,
              ∀ (P : SerrePositivity.PerfSupp T (⇑(algebraMap A T) ∘ z)),
                χ (SerrePositivity.K0.mk P) = SerrePositivity.chiLam lam (algebraMap T C) ↑P

SerrePositivity.lemma_3_5b.type:
@SerrePositivity.lemma_3_5b : ∀ {A T C : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : CommRing T] [inst_2 : Algebra A T]
  [inst_3 : CommRing C] [inst_4 : Algebra T C] [inst_5 : Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A T C] {e : ℕ} {z : Fin e → A}
  [inst_7 : IsRegularLocalRing A] [Module.Finite A T]
  {lam : SerrePositivity.NormalizedLength C (Ideal.map (algebraMap A C) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A))},
  Ideal.span (Set.range z) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A →
    ringKrullDim A = ↑e →
      (∀ (i : ℕ), 0 < i → lam.len (SerrePositivity.koszulHomologySelf (⇑(algebraMap A C) ∘ z) i) = 0) →
        lam.len (C ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range (⇑(algebraMap A C) ∘ z))) = ↑(Module.finrank A T) →
          (∀ (v j : ℕ), lam.len (SerrePositivity.koszulHomologySelf (fun k => (algebraMap A C) (z k ^ v)) j) ≠ ⊤) →
            ∀ [inst_9 : IsLocalRing T],
              Function.Surjective ⇑((IsLocalRing.residue T).comp (algebraMap A T)) →
                ∀ (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat A) ℤ),
                  SerrePositivity.IsPerfectSupported z Q →
                    SerrePositivity.chiOrd (SerrePositivity.baseChange (algebraMap A T) Q) =
                        ↑(Module.finrank A T) * SerrePositivity.chiOrd Q ∧
                      SerrePositivity.chiLam lam (algebraMap T C) (SerrePositivity.baseChange (algebraMap A T) Q) =
                        ↑(Module.finrank A T) * SerrePositivity.chiOrd Q

SerrePositivity.Asymptotic.paperRankBett.type:
@SerrePositivity.Asymptotic.paperRankBetti_koszul_formula : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Nontrivial R]
  {s : ℕ → ℕ} {J : Ideal R} (lam : SerrePositivity.NormalizedLength R J) (hfg : J.FG) {e : ℕ} (z : Fin e → R)
  (hJ : J ≤ (Ideal.span (Set.range z)).radical)
  (hfin :
    ∀ (v : ℕ),
      0 < v → ∀ (i : ℤ), lam.len ↑(HomologicalComplex.homology (SerrePositivity.koszulComplex fun j => z j ^ v) i) ≠ ⊤)
  (U : Ultrafilter ℕ) (hU : ↑U ≤ Filter.atTop) (hs : ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < s n)
  (K : CochainComplex (SerrePositivity.Asymptotic.FreeSequence R s) ℤ)
  (hK : SerrePositivity.strictlyBoundedComplex (SerrePositivity.Asymptotic.FreeSequence R s) K)
  (h :
    SerrePositivity.Asymptotic.paperSupportedRank z
      ((SerrePositivity.Asymptotic.paperSequenceFunctor R s).obj (SerrePositivity.Asymptotic.sequenceHomotopyObj K hK)))
  (v : ℕ),
  0 < v →
    (∀ (j : Fin e),
        z j ^ v •
            CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id
              ((SerrePositivity.Asymptotic.paperSequenceFunctor R s).obj
                (SerrePositivity.Asymptotic.sequenceHomotopyObj K hK)) =
          0) →
      ∀ (i : ℤ),
        (SerrePositivity.Asymptotic.normalizedLimit U s fun n =>
            (lam.len
                ↑(HomologicalComplex.homology
                    (SerrePositivity.koszulComplexOn (fun j => z j ^ v)
                      ((SerrePositivity.Asymptotic.evaluateComplex n).obj K))
                    (-i))).toReal) =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (e + 1),
            ↑(e.choose j) *
              SerrePositivity.Asymptotic.paperRankBetti lam hfg z hJ hfin U hU hs
                {
                  obj :=
                    (SerrePositivity.Asymptotic.paperSequenceFunctor R s).obj
                      (SerrePositivity.Asymptotic.sequenceHomotopyObj K hK),
                  property := h }
                (-(i - ↑j))

  (U : Ultrafilter ℕ) (hU : ↑U ≤ Filter.atTop) (hs : ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < s n)
  (K : CochainComplex (SerrePositivity.Asymptotic.FreeSequence R s) ℤ)
  (hK : SerrePositivity.strictlyBoundedComplex (SerrePositivity.Asymptotic.FreeSequence R s) K)
  (h :
    SerrePositivity.Asymptotic.paperSupportedRank z
      ((SerrePositivity.Asymptotic.paperSequenceFunctor R s).obj (SerrePositivity.Asymptotic.sequenceHomotopyObj K hK)))
  (v : ℕ),
  0 < v →
    (∀ (j : Fin e),
        z j ^ v •

              ((SerrePositivity.Asymptotic.paperSequenceFunctor R s).obj
                (SerrePositivity.Asymptotic.sequenceHomotopyObj K hK)) =

                (-(i - ↑j))

SerrePositivity.Section4.paperBaseChange.type:
@SerrePositivity.Section4.paperBaseChangeEulerK0_eq_koszulEuler_mul : ∀ {A S C : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing A]
  [inst_1 : IsLocalRing A] [inst_2 : IsNoetherianRing A] [HasDerivedCategory (ModuleCat A)] [inst_4 : CommRing S]
  [inst_5 : Nontrivial S] [inst_6 : CommRing C] [inst_7 : Nontrivial C] (α : A →+* S) (φ : S →+* C) {J : Ideal C}
  (lam : SerrePositivity.NormalizedLength C J) (hfg : J.FG) {e : ℕ} (z : Fin e → A)
  (hJ : J ≤ (Ideal.span (Set.range (⇑φ ∘ ⇑α ∘ z))).radical)
  (hfin : SerrePositivity.LengthAlgebra.KoszulFinite lam (⇑φ ∘ ⇑α ∘ z))
  (hz : Ideal.span (Set.range z) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A),
  SerrePositivity.IsKoszulResolution z →
    ∀ {s : ℕ → ℕ} (U : Ultrafilter ℕ) (hU : ↑U ≤ Filter.atTop) (hs : ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < s n),
      (SerrePositivity.Asymptotic.paperBaseChangeEulerK0 φ (⇑α ∘ z) lam hfg hJ hfin U hU hs).comp
          (SerrePositivity.TriangulatedK0.map (SerrePositivity.Asymptotic.paperSupportedChangeRing α z)) =
        SerrePositivity.LengthAlgebra.koszulEuler lam (⇑φ ∘ ⇑α ∘ z) •
          SerrePositivity.Section4.ordinaryPaperEulerK0 z ⋯ U hU hs
